theorems.name: Submission.frt_weighted_approx_tangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 < θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n]) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → V.weight B = ∫⁻ y in B ∩ M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂μHE[n]) → HasTangentPlane V x T (θ x) → ∀ S : Grassmannian N n, Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x S.plane ↔ S = T
